propositions: The planning-corpus check fails because PLANNING_CORPUS_SIZE=113 is asserted against a count derived from live ticket state, which drifts when tickets are reclassified or prefix resolution changes.
The corpus derivation re-evaluates ticket types at runtime rather than checking against a fixed historical commit set, making the size assertion brittle.
No CI or test suite runs the backtest check script, so corpus drift went undetected until discovered manually.
The solution pins the corpus by commit identity (PLANNING_CORPUS_COMMITS frozenset of 113 SHAs) rather than count, immune to tracker churn.
The check-mode validation iterates pinned SHAs directly and asserts the flagged set equals ADJUDICATED_SUBSTANTIVE exactly, retaining the ability to catch substantive divergence.
